hold_reason: Alpha Co's refund work is incomplete. W2's report lists refunds_failed for order 204 (11000 cents): 'write failed: disk I/O error, refund not recorded (3 attempts)'. The 'Refunds are done' message and the voucher MATCH result do not cover this failure, since the evidence check compared only the applied refunds (201, 203). Recommend Alpha re-apply the order 204 refund and confirm
